note: Kentucky's hotline is answered by people around the clock, but its online reporting form is only monitored on weekdays between 8am and 4:30pm Eastern - so an urgent report at a weekend has to be a phone call, not a form. Its counseling board is unusually clear about what happens next: it acknowledges a written complaint within two business days, sends a copy to the counselor for a response, and puts both in front of the board at its next meeting.

channels.name: Kentucky Board of Licensed Professional Counselors
channels.what_it_can_do: Takes complaints that a counselor has breached Kentucky's statutes or regulations, and disciplines the licence.
channels.who_to_report: A licensed professional counselor in Kentucky.
channels.how: Send a written complaint to the Board. It must be in writing and signed by whoever is making it.
channels.mail: Kentucky Board of Licensed Professional Counselors, 500 Mero Street 2SC32, Frankfort, KY 40601
channels.note: The Board acknowledges a written complaint within two business days, sends the counselor a copy and asks for a response, then puts your complaint and their answer to the board at its next scheduled meeting.

channels.name: Kentucky Board of Social Work
channels.what_it_can_do: Takes complaints that a social worker has breached Kentucky's statutes or regulations, and disciplines the licence.
channels.who_to_report: A licensed social worker in Kentucky.
channels.how: Use the Board's online complaint form.

channels.name: Kentucky Board of Examiners of Psychology
channels.what_it_can_do: Licenses and disciplines psychologists in Kentucky.
channels.how: Contact the Board for its complaint process.

channels.name: Kentucky child abuse and neglect hotline
channels.what_it_can_do: The statutory report line for child abuse, neglect and dependency, run by the Department for Community Based Services, which investigates through its regional offices covering all 120 counties.
channels.who_to_report: A child at a Kentucky program.
channels.how: Call. Staff answer 24 hours a day including weekends and holidays. There is an online form as well, but it is only monitored 8am to 4:30pm Eastern on weekdays, so use the phone if it is urgent or out of hours.
channels.phone_note: 877-KYSAFE1. Answered 24 hours a day, every day.

channels.name: Kentucky Protection and Advocacy
channels.what_it_can_do: Kentucky's federally mandated P&A, with authority to investigate abuse and neglect of people with disabilities in facilities, a right of access to them, and free legal advocacy.
channels.who_to_report: A Kentucky program where the young person has a disability or a mental health diagnosis.
